Naa neethi sooryudaa – naa yesu daivamaa

translation: Chorus
O Great Benefactor, O Living God!
O Gracious Jesus, I will praise You forever and ever.
Even if generations change or ages pass away,
Your love is eternal, Your love is divine nectar.
Verse 1
O Adorable God, O Priceless Bond!
Shining like a crore of suns within the borders of my heart.
Walking right behind me like a shadow on countless paths,
Being a strong fortress in my hours of weakness.
Staying with me as my soul’s dearest friend,
May Your grace be my very life here on earth.
O Sun of Righteousness, O Jesus my God,
O cloud that shelters me all through my life!
Verse 2
The only wealth I desire is the embrace of Your love,
Your living word is the courtyard of my safety and well-being.
I cannot even imagine the works of Your hands,
I cannot fully describe Your great sacrifice.
Leader of Zion, You are my true example,
My good shepherd on this journey of faith.
O Sun of Righteousness, O Jesus my God,
My sustaining lamp all through my life!
intro: Mahopakaaruda is the latest Telugu Christian song written by Joshua Shaik, sung by Arunita Kanjilal and music composed by Pranam Kamlakhar. This song was released on July 15, 2026, through JOSHUA SHAIK MINISTRIES YouTube Channel.
